preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, the number of friends k must be less than the number of rooms n, and n must not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= x_i <= n for x_i in friends)
preconditions.description: Each friend's room number x_i must be between 2 and n.
All friends must be in different rooms.
The total number of rooms across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: If Vlad can win, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum number of friends needed to catch Vlad.
The minimum number of friends required must be non-negative.
The minimum number of friends required cannot exceed the total number of friends k.
